engagement.scope: Customer chat on the website, Italian and English; five approved intents answered, four escalation intents always handed to a person.

milestones.name: Discovery: top contact reasons, handoff paths and approved content owners mapped
Scope and success criteria signed by the sponsor
Approved answers (IT/EN) signed off by the content owner
Offline evaluation gate passed on the held-out test set
Pilot live on 10% of chat traffic
Decision: widen to 50% of chat traffic
Handover: client team runs content updates and the weekly review
Close: value review against the week-3 baseline

reasons: offline gate passed and every pilot target met in the last two weeks
recommendation.rule: Widen only if the offline gate passed and every pilot target was met in each of the last two pilot weeks.

baseline.source: client contact-centre report for the four weeks before the engagement (fictional)

risks.risk: Handoff queue not staffed for the pilot volume; customers wait after the agent hands over
New tariff letters in week 11 may spike bill questions beyond the approved answers
Content updates still depend on the delivery team

decisions_needed: Week 10: Decision: widen to 50% of chat traffic (recommendation by rule: widen)
